---
title: "Insurance Agent: Commission"
---

## Task

An insurance agent wants to use a program to calculate their commission for all
contracts concluded during one month. For each contract, the agent receives
€50 plus 1% of the sum insured.

End the input when the agent enters `0` as the sum insured.

## Sample interaction

```text
Sum insured: 1000
Sum insured: 2000
Sum insured: 3000
Sum insured: 0
Commission: 210.0
```
